title: Seamless Connectivity: The Power of Integrating Power Line and Wireless Communications
affiliation: Federal University of Juiz de Fora / Federal University of Paraná / Peraton Labs / Princeton University
domain: Hybrid Communications / Power Line Communications / Wireless Communications / Smart Grid / IoT / Industry 4.0

analysis_policy.focus: Extract three-type categorization, strengths-weaknesses parallel structure, chrono-tech-industry triple coverage, lessons learned synthesis
analysis_policy.depth: Full paper analysis including historical evolution, standardization efforts, qualitative assessment

section_flow.title: Introduction
subsections: Motivation and Comparison With Previous Contributions
section_flow.summary: Establishes historical context from 1911 wired-wireless to modern hybrid systems. Identifies gap in comprehensive treatment. Lists 7 specific contributions.
key_claims: First hybrid communication system emerged in 1911 (wired-wireless)
No prior survey comprehensively covers all three types of hybrid PLC-WLC systems
Integration exploits time, frequency, and space diversities

section_flow.title: Power Line Communication Systems
section_flow.summary: Covers PLC fundamentals with NB/BB frequency bands. Details 5 strengths (pervasive infrastructure, connectivity, power-data-sensing, cost-effectiveness, coverage) and 8 weaknesses (load dynamics, coupling cost, impedance, etc.).

section_flow.title: Wireless Communication Systems
section_flow.summary: Covers WLC from frequencies up to 6 GHz with focus on integration potential. Details strengths (mobility, flexibility, ease, cost-effectiveness, rapid deployment) and weaknesses (signal degradation, interference, security, regulatory, reduced coverage).

section_flow.title: Hybrid Communication Systems
subsections: Why We Should Integrate PLC and WLC Systems?
section_flow.summary: Explains integration rationale with Table IV comparison. Introduces three-type categorization: wired-wireless, one-hop PLC/WLC, two-hop PLC/WLC.

section_flow.title: Hybrid Wired-Wireless Systems
section_flow.summary: Covers oldest type from 1911. Technical details on SISO/MIMO configurations. Chronological research evolution with Table V summary.

section_flow.title: Hybrid One-Hop PLC/WLC Systems
section_flow.summary: Most investigated type. Covers diversity strategies (multiplexing, transmit, selection, receive). Table VI chronological summary. Industrial: Itron, SEMTECH, TI, STMicroelectronics, G3-PLC Alliance.

section_flow.title: Hybrid Two-Hop PLC/WLC Systems
section_flow.summary: Simplest type for Wi-Fi extension. IEEE 1905.1 standard coverage. Table VII chronological summary. Industrial products: Qualcomm, Devolo, TP-Link.

section_flow.title: Design Approaches for Hybrid Communication Systems
section_flow.summary: Two design approaches: leveraging existing standards vs software-defined hybrid transceiver. Discusses complexity-performance trade-offs.

section_flow.title: Qualitative Assessment of Hybrid Communication Systems
section_flow.summary: Table VIII provides multi-dimensional comparison across all three types using 15 criteria. Discussion of each hybrid system's suitability for different scenarios.

section_flow.title: Lessons Learned
section_flow.summary: Per-type lessons learned synthesis with specific insights for each hybrid communication type.

section_flow.title: Research Opportunities and Future Trends
section_flow.summary: Extensive bullet-point lists covering future research topics for each hybrid type and convergent areas.

section_flow.title: Concluding Remarks
section_flow.summary: Synthesizes survey coverage and emphasizes hybrid systems' role in smart grid, IoT, Industry 4.0/5.0.

rhetorical_contract.promise: Comprehensive multidimensional discussion of PLC+WLC hybrid communication systems from technical, historical, industrial, and standardization perspectives
rhetorical_contract.delivery_mechanism: Individual technologies → Integration rationale → Three-type parallel coverage → Design approaches → Qualitative assessment → Lessons learned
rhetorical_contract.unique_contribution: First survey covering all three types of PLC-WLC integration with 120-year historical perspective from 1911 to present

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Organize technology coverage with explicit parallel Strengths and Weaknesses subsections enabling direct comparison
structure: A. Strengths: Bullet-point list of advantages (5-8 items)
B. Weaknesses: Parallel bullet-point list of disadvantages (5-8 items)
Each strength/weakness has descriptive title + explanation paragraph
Use consistent structure for all technologies being compared
Reference this structure in integration rationale section
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Section II (PLC: 5 strengths, 8 weaknesses) and Section III (WLC: 6 strengths, 5 weaknesses) use identical structure
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Enables systematic comparison; justifies integration; provides reference for later synthesis

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Organize multi-type survey with parallel section structure for each type, enabling systematic comparison
structure: Each type gets dedicated section (V, VI, VII)
Each section has parallel subsections: A. Technical Aspects, B. Research Evolution, C. Industrial/Standardization
Research Evolution uses chronological narrative
Each section ends with comprehensive chronological table
Some sections skip C if no industrial activity exists
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Sections V (wired-wireless: A,B only), VI (one-hop: A,B,C), VII (two-hop: A,B,C) follow same template
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Comprehensive coverage; easy navigation; systematic comparison between types

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Summarize research evolution with year-based tables including contribution ratings
structure: Columns: Year, Reference, Description, Parameters, Config/Freq, Rating
Rows ordered chronologically
Rating uses star system (★☆☆ to ★★★) with footnote explaining criteria
Description column summarizes contribution in one sentence
Parameters column lists evaluated metrics
Separate table for each major topic/type
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Table V (wired-wireless, 14 entries), Table VI (one-hop, 30+ entries), Table VII (two-hop, 15+ entries)
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Quantifies contribution importance; shows research maturity; guides reader to key papers

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Compare multiple systems/technologies across criteria using visual star ratings
structure: Rows: Comparison criteria (10-15 items)
Columns: Each system/technology being compared
Cells: Star ratings (★☆☆, ★★☆, ★★★)
Include footnote explaining rating scale meaning
Group related criteria together
Discuss each criterion in prose after table
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Table IV (PLC vs WLC vs Hybrid, 10 criteria), Table VIII (three hybrid types, 15 criteria)
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Quick visual comparison; identifies strengths/gaps; guides system selection
reusable_writing_recipes.complexity: Medium - requires systematic evaluation across criteria

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Dedicate a section to synthesizing lessons learned organized by the survey's main categories
structure: Section title: 'Lessons Learned' or similar
Subsection for each major type/category
Each subsection contains 3-6 key insights in prose
Insights derived from research evolution analysis
Include both achievements and remaining gaps
Write in accessible, mentor-like tone
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Section X with subsections for each of three hybrid types, each with synthesized insights
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Actionable insights; prevents redundant research; guides future work
reusable_writing_recipes.complexity: Medium - requires synthesis of extensive literature

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Open survey with historical origin story establishing technology's long evolution
structure: Open introduction with earliest historical reference (specific year)
Trace evolution through key milestones

Include interesting historical facts/terminology
